name: nonfictionhotlist
description: The Nonfiction Hotlist, one site per year at list.nonfictionhotlist.com, built from Google Drive editing kits

scripts.test:kit: node scripts/content/build-kit.js && rm -rf .kit-test && node scripts/content/fake-drive.js .kit-test/fake && node scripts/content/pull-drive.js --from-dir .kit-test/fake --dry-run && node drive-kit/test/mock-run.js .kit-test/mock --slow-clock > /dev/null && node scripts/content/pull-drive.js --from-dir .kit-test/mock --dry-run
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run dashboard && npm run pdf && npm run check
scripts.release:all: npm run root && node scripts/each-year.js release
scripts.serve: npm run root && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory site
